arm_b2_feature_list: depth_abs_std (corpus-wide standardized absolute depth, shares Arm B-abs's reference frame)

context_tokens_to_metres.note: raw per-depth-sample context, not the FSQ tokenizer's patch16 grouping

depth_abs_standardization.note: corpus-wide, computed from 80 train wells only, item V

depth_scale_precheck.reference_frame_defect_note: dnorm is position-within-well, not absolute depth; same normalized value means different real depths across wells

generation_cap.real_interval_matching: real_segment = feats_real[prime_n:prime_n+gen_len], exact match to generated window
generation_cap.window_start_policy: fixed at prime_n=max(CONTEXT, PRIME_FRAC*well_len), not randomized per realization

nphi_relative_bias_definition: 100 * (mean(generated_NPHI) - mean(real_NPHI)) / mean(real_NPHI), denominator = REAL/reference mean, per item D's corrected framing
tokenizer_provenance: refit_on_force_80_train_wells (item U: reverts item S after v1 tokenizer failed validation gate)
w1_definition: scipy.stats.wasserstein_distance(real_NPHI_segment, generated_NPHI_segment), own definition per item D's pre-registered fallback (v1's W1 definition unresolved)
